title: Invertible mates when fully faithful embeddings preserve the right-adjoint image
statement: Given adjunctions L1 ⊣ R1 and L2 ⊣ R2, fully faithful functors G and H, and an isomorphism G followed by L2 ≅ L1 followed by H, the canonical right mate R1 followed by G → H followed by R2 is invertible provided every R2(H(d)) lies in the essential image of G.

source.place: Hom-set proof of Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful; agent-written Yoneda variant using only essential-image membership

proof.text: Write each target as G(t). Full faithfulness lifts the mate to f:R1(d)→t. The two adjunction Hom equivalences, full faithfulness of H and G, and the left isomorphism identify postcomposition by f with a composite of bijections. This equality is proved using the mate formula and naturality of the unit and left comparison.
The Yoneda isomorphism criterion proves f invertible, hence its image and the mate component are invertible. Apply the componentwise natural-transformation criterion.
